mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced discount rates for equity valuations, as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 5.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing and construction sectors weaken.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., 20-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 305.0 signals inflationary pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed may accelerate rate hikes.
failure_condition: In periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, CPIAUCSL rises above 305.0 but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals strong demand for housing and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained consumer spending growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising RSAFS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 over the past month signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in strong economic growth.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., 20-day returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 157,000 thousand signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: In periods of UNRATE < 4.0%, PAYEMS falls below 157000.0 but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.
